GoodRoulette.title: Free revive
GoodRoulette.description: You revive for free on your first death.

GoodRoulette.title: Lucky shots
GoodRoulette.description: All shots have a 1% chance of dealing critical damage.

GoodRoulette.title: Tesla Field
GoodRoulette.description: Kills the first zombie who gets in your Melee range.

GoodRoulette.title: Barbarian Serum
GoodRoulette.description: You deal 25% more damage with your Melee weapon.

GoodRoulette.title: Metal Detector
GoodRoulette.description: You’ll earn 15% more coins this game!

GoodRoulette.title: Zen Focus
GoodRoulette.description: Hitting enemies is a bit easier.

GoodRoulette.title: Golden Bullet
GoodRoulette.description: All your weapons carry 10% more bullets (minimum 1 extra bullet!)

BadRoulette.title: Cows
BadRoulette.description: Stupid cows are walking around. Harmless, but noisy...

BadRoulette.title: Parking lot
BadRoulette.description: Car alarms will go off around you. Shoot them to blow up the cars!

BadRoulette.title: Jukebox
BadRoulette.description: An old jukebox keeps playing terrible music. Shoot it to stop it!

BadRoulette.title: Thunderstorm
BadRoulette.description: Rain and random thunder hinder your hearing.

BadRoulette.title: Rusty Weapons
BadRoulette.description: Your weapons have a chance of jamming, forcing you to reload.

BadRoulette.title: Elite zombies
BadRoulette.description: Uh-oh, Zombies have 20% more hit points!

BadRoulette.title: Earpiece
BadRoulette.description: Dr. Bastard will yell directions in your ear.

BadRoulette.title: Enraged Horde
BadRoulette.description: Get ready! Zombies will get increasingly faster and tougher!

BadRoulette.title: Generator Malfunction
BadRoulette.description: That noisy generator is not working properly. Shoot it to turn it off ... for a while.

BadRoulette.title: Toy Sword
BadRoulette.description: Your melee weapon deals 25% less damage.

BadRoulette.title: Zombies With Helmets!
BadRoulette.description: Landing critical hits is twice as hard.

BadRoulette.title: Rigged Guns
BadRoulette.description: Your accuracy is slightly reduced. You’ll have to aim more carefully!
